biggest_catch: Earnings are entirely variable - microstock per-download amounts are tiny ($0.216-$0.432 for subscription downloads) and you only climb royalty tiers with volume.
catches: Tiered commissions: 30-60% by contributor level based on downloads in the trailing 12 months; higher tiers need up to 1M+ downloads
Subscription downloads pay only $0.216-$0.432 each; credits sales pay 30-60% of license price
Paid automatically on the 15th of the month only after reaching the US $50 minimum payout threshold
Accepts photos, vectors, video, audio, and fonts; all content goes through an approval process
Refunds, cancellations, and fraudulent downloads can be reversed

c1.evidence: 123RF (123rf.com) - stock content marketplace. Official 'Commission Structure' at 123rf.com/contrib_structure/ and 'Sign up as a 123RF Content Contributor' at 123rf.com/sellimages/, fetched 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: Official: 'Earn between 30% - 60% commissions from each license sold.' Tier table: Level 1 (0-999 downloads) $0.216 subscription / 30% credits ... Level 8 (>1,000,000) $0.432 / 60%. 'ALL payments are made automatically on the 15th of every month ... i.e. if you've reached US$50.00 worth of commissions' via PayPal, Skrill, Payoneer or Alipay.

c3.evidence: Concretely conditional: sign up as contributor, upload, pass approval, earn on downloads.

c4.evidence: No entry fee; signup and uploading are free. Not pay-to-play.
